name: 20-vxlan-base
note: frr plus core mix with in-device VXLAN interfaces. `br100` is a Linux bridge over `vtep100` (a kernel-random vxlan MAC) and `eth0` (a plugin-random one), so the address it inherits — the smallest of the two — is a coin flip per deploy: three Python deploys gave eth0, vtep100, eth0. It is the only interface in the corpus whose MAC is kernel-derived from unpinned addresses; 10-one-bridge's `mainbridge` is the same construct over four MACs the lab pins, so its inheritance stays a real assertion.
